source_policy_note: Official EU and elite institutes plus selected high-quality research-system/workforce institutions and top journals. Manual geopolitical evidence is admitted explicitly and preserved; curated workbook entries are discovery seeds and still pass automated admission gates. Accepted historical evidence is cumulative: normal scans add and enrich but do not silently remove previously accepted rows.
cutoff_rule: Historical sources are those published before the rolling main-radar boundary (today minus main_radar_window_months). Content may itself be forward-looking.
coverage_rotation_note: Historical discovery rotates persistently across topic families, source batches, two-year publication bands, direct-source depth pages, curated seeds, and known-good authors. Low-yield continuation moves into fresh cells inside the same daily run; it never lowers admission quality.
shared_main_query_policy: Historical rotates through the same Main A and B query grammar, but only inside publication windows strictly older than the rolling six-month cutoff.
admission_policy: New historical items must pass the Main scanner gate_scope/final worthiness logic plus Historical source-age and trusted-source constraints. C is never reconstructed historically.
schedule_note: Every four hours at minute 57 UTC, after Main; same A/B gate, only publication dates older than the rolling six-month Main window.
